channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Idukki to Host New Agricultural Research Station for Plantations
item.description: Kerala authorities approved a new technology-focused research facility at the Government Engineering College in Idukki. The center seeks to help the struggling plantation industry overcome current difficulties using modern tech.

item.title: Chief Minister claims KCR takes water unlawfully for property
item.description: The Chief Minister has accused KCR of unauthorized water extraction for his personal residence. The allegation highlights an ongoing dispute over resource usage.

item.title: Pundits Review Manchester City's Seventh Consecutive Victory
item.description: Match of the Day analysts Joe Hart and Danny Murphy evaluated Manchester City's 3-2 triumph over Ipswich. The result keeps the club's 100 percent winning streak alive in the Premier League season.

item.title: দৈনন্দিন জীবনে রাগ নিয়ন্ত্রণের গুরুত্ব ও ইসলামি দৃষ্টিকোণ
item.description: রাস্তার নানা অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিত পরিস্থিতি বা যানজটে মেজাজ হারিয়ে ফেলা খুবই স্বাভাবিক। তবে মুমিনের প্রকৃত শক্তি প্রকাশ পায় ক্রোধ সংযত করার মাধ্যমে।

item.title: Supreme Court Rules Prior Sanction Unnecessary to Prosecute Bribe-Taking Officials
item.description: The Supreme Court stated that official authorization is not required to move forward with the prosecution of government employees caught seeking bribes. This ruling removes a key legal hurdle in corruption cases.

item.title: Rubio Plans Jamnagar Visit as Musk Responds to Reliance
item.description: Marco Rubio includes Jamnagar in his two-day travel schedule. Meanwhile, Elon Musk recently acknowledged and praised a social media post regarding Reliance.

item.title: Healthcare Staff Announce Strikes Amid Stormont Budget Impasse
item.description: Hospital physicians in Northern Ireland declared upcoming strikes after losing patience with prolonged budget postponements by Stormont. Earlier effects of the funding delay had appeared minimal until this escalation.

item.title: Causes of Evening Wi-Fi Slowdowns and How to Fix Them
item.description: Network congestion caused by high user traffic in the evening frequently reduces internet speeds. Users can apply simple methods to bypass these common connectivity slowdowns.

item.title: Satellite Images Reveal Luxury Vessel Near Kim Jong Un Estate
item.description: Recent satellite photos display a high-end boat featuring a 50-meter pool and water slides situated close to a summer property utilized by Kim Jong Un. This luxury contrasts sharply with the living conditions of average North Korean citizens.

item.title: Dubois Defeats Wardley in Two Rounds
item.description: Daniel Dubois secured his standing as Britain's top heavyweight. He stopped Fabio Wardley in the second round to keep his WBO title.

item.title: Muttahida Majlis-e-Ulema Coordinates Sermons
item.description: More than 70 congregations in Kashmir, Jammu, and Ladakh addressed the theme of faith on Friday, October 16. The coordinated effort was organized by the Muttahida Majlis-e-Ulema.

item.title: Maintaining Smart Home Operations Offline
item.description: Many smart home devices rely on Wi-Fi connectivity to operate. This guide examines methods to maintain functionality during internet outages.

item.title: Official Urges Globally Competitive Media
item.description: A senior Information and Broadcasting ministry official encouraged the creation of competitive media and entertainment firms. The goal is to establish India as a major provider of content, talent, and technology.

item.title: TDP Leader Comments on Jagan's Corruption Cases
item.description: TDP politician Varla Ramaiah stated that YSRCP leader Jagan cannot avoid ongoing corruption trials. He noted that courts will now hold daily proceedings after 15 years of delays.

item.title: Muhammad Ali Training Camp Restored as Museum
item.description: Fighter's Heaven, the 1972 training camp of Muhammad Ali, underwent a $1.5 million restoration funded by Mike Madden. The renovated site has now reopened as a museum.

item.title: Ladakh Chief Secretary Discusses Regional Demands
item.description: The Ladakh Chief Secretary stated the central government remains dedicated to addressing regional needs. Local civil society groups previously rejected a Home Ministry proposal for a directly elected territorial body.

item.title: Rare Gold LEGO Mask Fetches High Price
item.description: A 14-karat gold Bionicle mask discovered in a Pennsylvania Goodwill donation bag was initially priced at $14.95. Competitive bidding eventually drove the final sale price up to $18,101.

item.title: French Demonstrations Lead to Major Unrest and Over 1,200 Arrests
item.description: Widespread unrest in France resulted in looting, fires, and more than 1,200 detentions. President Macron has promised a firm response to the escalating violence.

item.title: Understanding and Tracking Background Activity on Personal Computers
item.description: Keeping track of hidden computer processes helps users understand system operations. It also allows individuals to identify unusual activity on their devices.

item.title: Ukraine Restarts Refinery Strikes Amid Strain in U.S. Diplomacy
item.description: Ukrainian forces have renewed attacks on Russian petroleum facilities. President Zelenskyy noted concerns over shifting U.S. relations under Donald Trump.

item.title: Delayed New Yalu River Crossing Links China and North Korea
item.description: A newly completed bridge connecting China and North Korea has finally opened. The project faced delays exceeding ten years following initial construction.

item.title: Rescue Operations Underway After Vessel Overturns Near Baja California
item.description: U.S. and Mexican forces are actively searching for individuals missing after a boat capsized. Sixteen survivors have already been rescued from the water.

item.title: Haryana Political Clash: Chief Minister and Congress Exchange Barbs
item.description: Haryana CM Saini touted regional prosperity while criticizing past governance. Meanwhile, Congress accused the administration of increasing debt and crime.

item.title: Violent Clashes Erupt Across France During Nationwide Demonstrations
item.description: Recent protests throughout the nation escalated into severe unrest. Rioters set fire to vehicles and buildings while looting local stores.

item.title: Hearts Prepare for Celtic Clash at Parkhead
item.description: On Sunday, Hearts will play Celtic at Parkhead for the first time since their championship hopes ended there in an 11-minute span last season. The Edinburgh club comes into the match following a period of roster changes and rest.

item.title: Significant Price Reductions Announced for 137 Cancer Medications
item.description: The costs of 137 oncology drugs will drop by as much as 70 percent. The new pricing structure is scheduled to take effect starting November 9.

item.title: SFI Declares Wins at Thirty Kozhikode Colleges
item.description: The student group SFI announced it secured victories during student union elections across thirty campuses located in Kozhikode.

item.title: Award Given to Ammar Kizhuparamba for Gulf Migration Novel
item.description: A literary prize has been granted to Ammar Kizhuparamba for his book focusing on the early history of migration to the Gulf region.

item.title: Ramlila Maidan Included in July Police Surveillance Tender
item.description: Authorities released a procurement notice in July for security cameras at several locations, which featured Ramlila Maidan.

item.title: Detained Demonstrator Faces Potential Ear Surgery After Beating
item.description: Medical documents indicate a protester suffered a perforated eardrum after being struck by police for filming officers mistreating detainees.

item.title: Kerala Chief Minister Discusses Sabari Rail Project Revival
item.description: The Chief Minister stated that authorities are working to restart the Sabari rail line using the state's fifty percent funding. The railway ministry was asked to contribute its matching share for the initiative, which was valued at ₹3,800 crore in 2023.

item.title: Tamil Nadu to Offer Parboiled Rice at ₹30 per Kilogram
item.description: A state minister announced that parboiled rice will be made available at ₹30 per kg at 260 cooperative outlets and Amudham stores.

item.title: Weather Network Expansion Delayed Due to Land Scarcity
item.description: The agriculture ministry's weather station deployment is delayed by a year, with over ninety-six percent of units remaining uninstalled. Private partners noted that the IMD now demands sensors be placed on the ground rather than rooftops.

item.title: BJP Women MPs Petition Lok Sabha Speaker Over JNU Harassment
item.description: Female BJP parliamentarians met with the Lok Sabha Speaker to seek measures against Professor Akoijam. Complainants stated he invited students to his home under the guise of gatherings and subjected them to sexual harassment.

item.title: Kozhikode implements strict traffic rules for Vice-President visit
item.description: Kozhikode will enforce traffic limitations starting Friday afternoon along the Vice-President's transit corridor, running from Ramanattukara to Chalappu through multiple key junctions.

item.title: Green Visakha demands revocation of data centre approvals
item.description: The day following a public march, the Green Visakha organization demanded that authorities revoke all permits previously issued for a local data centre.

item.title: Delhi High Court queries slow progress on open prisons
item.description: The Delhi High Court has expressed concern regarding the prolonged inaction in establishing open and semi-open correctional facilities.

item.title: Madras High Court voids takeover order for Chennai land
item.description: The Madras High Court overturned a single judge's directive instructing the Tamil Nadu administration to seize 7.44 acres from the Sri Ramachandra Educational and Health Trust.

item.title: TDP set to run for Visakhapatnam mayoral post via NDA deal
item.description: Under the seat-sharing terms of the NDA alliance, the TDP has confirmed it will participate in the upcoming mayoral elections in Visakhapatnam.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi asks President to review Dushyant Gautam's role
item.description: Rahul Gandhi requested a presidential review of Dushyant Gautam's gubernatorial appointment, citing an active CBI investigation and constitutional immunity concerns.

item.title: Supreme Court opposes general internet restrictions for minors
item.description: The Supreme Court expressed skepticism toward broad internet prohibitions for children aimed at protection, noting that the effectiveness of such restrictions lacks proof.

item.title: টেইলর ও আরভিনের ব্যাটে জিম্বাবুয়ের সংগ্রহ ২৭১ রান
item.description: প্রাথমিক ব্যাটিং বিপর্যয়ের পর দলের ইনিংস সামাল দেন টেইলর ও আরভিন। তাদের দেড় শ রানের জুটি জিম্বাবুয়েকে দুই শ একাত্তর রানে পৌঁছে দেয়, যেখানে তাসকিন তিনটি উইকেট লাভ করেন।

item.title: Meta updates terms by deleting specific web scraping phrases
item.description: Meta has eliminated specific wording from its terms that previously sparked concerns regarding automated web scraping and artificial intelligence training.

item.title: Alternative uses for outdated PlayStation gaming systems
item.description: Even though legacy PlayStation consoles are aging, owners still have multiple options to repurpose them effectively instead of discarding them.

item.title: জিম্বাবুয়ের বিরুদ্ধে ব্যাটারদের ব্যর্থতায় হতাশ তাসকিন
item.description: জিম্বাবুয়ের বিপক্ষে শুরুতে তাসকিন আহমেদের বোলিংয়ে ২৪ রানে ৩ উইকেট হারিয়ে কোণঠাসা হয়ে পড়েছিল সফরকারীরা। সেখান থেকে ঘুরে দাঁড়িয়ে নির্ধারিত ৫০ ওভারে তারা ২৭২ রানের পুঁজি গড়ে তোলে। ম্যাচশেষে বাংলাদেশি এই পেসার জানান, ব্যাটারদের দায়িত্ব নিয়ে দলকে জেতানো প্রয়োজন ছিল।

item.title: Midterm voters encouraged to vote early during US-wide No Kings demonstrations
item.description: Thousands of participants attended events across the United States on Saturday as part of the ongoing No Kings movement. Demonstrators encouraged citizens to submit their midterm election ballots ahead of time. These gatherings build upon two years of previous marches.

item.title: এএফসি চ্যালেঞ্জ লিগে কাদসিয়ার বিপক্ষে হেরেছে ফর্টিস এফসি
item.description: মহাদেশীয় টুর্নামেন্ট এএফসি চ্যালেঞ্জ লিগের অভিষেক ম্যাচে কুয়েতের ক্লাব কাদসিয়ার মুখোমুখি হয় বাংলাদেশের ফর্টিস এফসি। কুয়েতের মোহাম্মদ আল-হামাদ স্টেডিয়ামে অনুষ্ঠিত খেলায় ফর্টিস ৩-০ ব্যবধানে পরাজিত হয়। প্রথমবারের মতো টুর্নামেন্টটিতে অংশ নেওয়া দুই দলের জন্য এটিই ছিল প্রথম গ্রুপ পর্বের লড়াই।

item.title: Manzambi scores winning goal for Aston Villa against Newcastle
item.description: Aston Villa continued their strong recent run of form with a victory over Newcastle United. Johan Manzambi secured the winning goal for his club. The player had previously selected a transfer to Villa Park over an offer from Newcastle.

item.title: Martha's Vineyard board denies 54-acre housing development
item.description: Following numerous lengthy sessions, the Martha's Vineyard planning board dismissed the Katama Meadows residential proposal. The initiative aimed to provide a combination of standard and affordable housing for essential personnel.

item.title: Violence breaks out between protesters and riot police in Albanian capital
item.description: Demonstrators targeting the government clashed with riot police in Tirana on Saturday. The violent confrontations persisted throughout the day across Albania's capital city.

item.title: Hundreds detained following nationwide cost of living demonstrations in France
item.description: Over 500,000 citizens participated in rallies against the rising cost of living across French cities. The nationwide demonstrations escalated into disorder, including fires, looting, and violent skirmishes. Authorities arrested hundreds of individuals in connection with the unrest.

item.title: Widespread protests over living costs spread across European nations
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators joined independent rallies in France, Belgium, Portugal, and Italy. The coordinated public pressure targets governments across the European Union concerning inflation and living expenses.

item.title: Discounted iPhone 18 devices promoted in Tehran following shipwreck
item.description: Advertisements for low-cost iPhone 18 units have appeared in Tehran, referred to as conflict spoils following a vessel sinking near Hormuz.

item.title: সিজেপি প্রধান অভিজিৎ দিপক শর্ত সাপেক্ষে মুক্তি পেলেন
item.description: শনিবার দিল্লির বিশেষ নির্বাহী ম্যাজিস্ট্রেটের সামনে হাজিরার পর সিজেপি প্রধান অভিজিৎ দিপককে শান্তিবাজারের মুচলেকায় মুক্তি দেওয়া হয়। তবে সংগঠনের দুই মুখপাত্র সৌরভ ও রাঙ্কা এখনো আটক রয়েছেন।

item.title: TikTok Permanently Blocks Ad Account Promoting Elon Musk Film
item.description: TikTok has permanently removed an advertising profile linked to a four-hour documentary about Elon Musk. The film continues to face pushback across various social media networks.

item.title: Montpellier Defeats Bath in Opening Champions Cup Fixture
item.description: Montpellier secured a victory over Bath during the first weekend of the Champions Cup. They overcame their opponents by scoring 22 unanswered points during the second half.

item.title: Bangladesh coastal resort fire claims ten lives
item.description: A blaze at a coastal resort in Bangladesh resulted in ten fatalities. Among the victims were six individuals belonging to a single household.

item.title: রমনা কালীমন্দিরে মহাসপ্তমী উদ্‌যাপিত
item.description: রাজধানীর রমনা কালীমন্দিরে ঢাকের বাদ্য ও ধূপের গন্ধে মুখর পরিবেশে মহাসপ্তমী পূজা উদ্‌যাপিত হয়েছে। এ সময় ভক্তরা দেবী দুর্গার কাছে দেশ ও মানুষের জন্য শান্তি ও কল্যাণ প্রার্থনা করেন।

item.title: Historical automobiles that utilized aerodynamic downforce fans
item.description: Prior to the Tesla Roadster, several vintage vehicles incorporated mechanical fans to generate aerodynamic downforce. This technical approach has a long history in automotive engineering.

item.title: Bayern Munich defeats RB Leipzig 6-1 as Diaz scores three goals
item.description: Luis Diaz secured a hat-trick and Harry Kane played his 100th Bundesliga match as Bayern Munich defeated RB Leipzig 6-1. The victory propelled Bayern to the summit of the league standings.
